boundary: trusted host -> tool-free model-data service; never a guest authority or a tool grant
authority: host callback must independently verify issuer, tenant, actor incarnation, epoch, revocation, expiration and permitted model data action; bool from guest, LLM or repository text is not evidence
claim: A durable atomic one-shot claim MUST use stable tenant_id + durable logical actor_id + dispatch_id; actor generation, activation epoch, exact revision and payload digest are independently authenticated but MUST NOT rotate the claim key. Immutable context SHA-256 recorded with the first claim. No auto-replay of unknown outcomes.

local_claim_directory_security.evidence_scope: Java and LLVM host-only local-filesystem prototype; not implemented in WASM/.NET/Forge or a native Oreslang guest
local_claim_directory_security.native_llvm: root-anchored openat walk with O_NOFOLLOW/O_DIRECTORY on every component; owner-only 0700 final directory; fsync file and directory
local_claim_directory_security.java: root-anchored SecureDirectoryStream with NOFOLLOW_LINKS on every path component, atomic CREATE_NEW relative to pinned directory, and FileChannel.force on the same pinned directory handle; verify POSIX owner with OS UnixSystem identity, never user.home. Reject non-SDS and non-FileChannel providers without fallback. Same-UID hostile initial directory substitution and independent provider/remote TOCTOU remain out of scope.

distributed_transactional_claim_v1.scope: HOST_ONLY PostgreSQL reference implemented in Java JDBC and LLVM libpq; WASM, .NET and Forge remain contract-only
distributed_transactional_claim_v1.invariant: At most one committed admission for (tenant_id, stable_logical_actor_id, dispatch_id) across all actors, generations, payloads and revisions
distributed_transactional_claim_v1.server_authorization: session_user bound to enabled tenant/actor row maintained by trusted administrator, locked FOR SHARE
distributed_transactional_claim_v1.actor_fence: generation, activation_epoch and exact revision locked FOR SHARE at transaction admission
distributed_transactional_claim_v1.storage: PRIMARY KEY tenant_id+actor_id+dispatch_id, INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, no expiry deletion or automatic retry after unknown commit
distributed_transactional_claim_v1.durability: function SET synchronous_commit=on; refuse server fsync=off; local service transaction success does NOT prove remote provider effects
distributed_transactional_claim_v1.provider: Independent signed/verified capability checks, idempotency and authenticated outcome reconciliation REQUIRED before production
